text.desc.item.tonic: A bitter herbal draught. Restores 30 HP to one ally.
text.desc.item.clear_gel: A cool salve that draws poison out of one ally.
text.desc.item.wake_chime: A small bell. Its ring wakes the whole party and frees stiff limbs.
text.desc.item.second_wind: Sharp smelling salts that stand a fallen ally up with some HP.
text.desc.item.spark_flask: A corked flask of crackling light. Thrown, it shocks one foe.
text.desc.item.loosen_oil: A drop of thin oil that frees an ally caught by Gear Lock.
text.desc.item.jolt_pod: A seed pod that bursts with a jolt on a foe chosen at random.
text.desc.item.homing_shell: Held to the ear, it hums the way home. Takes the party to a town of this region it has visited. Not in dungeons.
text.desc.item.waymark_chalk: Chalk that glows on the marks you passed. Leads the party out of a dungeon to where it went in.
text.desc.equipment.copper_blade: A short blade of beaten copper, light enough for quick cuts.
text.desc.equipment.ember_rod: A rod with a live coal in its tip. Its strikes carry heat.
text.desc.equipment.volley_sling: A sling that throws a spray of pebbles at a whole group.
text.desc.equipment.tin_cap: A dented tin cap. Better than nothing.
text.desc.equipment.padded_coat: A quilted coat that softens blows.
text.desc.equipment.rivet_plate: Heavy riveted plates. Sturdy, but they slow the wearer down.
text.desc.equipment.grip_bands: Leather bands that steady the hands for well placed strikes.
text.desc.equipment.calm_charm: A smooth stone charm. Its wearer cannot be put to sleep.
text.desc.equipment.spark_ring: A ring that hums faintly. Its wearer can call up Glint.
text.desc.equipment.drift_feather: A gull feather that makes its wearer quick and hard to hit.
text.desc.ability.strike: A plain blow with whatever is at hand.
text.desc.ability.ram: The hull drives straight into one foe.
text.desc.ability.scatter_shot: A spray of pebbles that hits every foe in a group.
text.desc.ability.spark: A snap of lightning at one foe.
text.desc.ability.ember: A fan of embers that scorches a group of foes.
text.desc.ability.frostbite: A sheet of frost settles on every foe.
text.desc.ability.hush: Seals one foe's techniques for the rest of the battle.
text.desc.ability.gust: A sharp gust slams into one foe.
text.desc.ability.weaken: Loosens one foe's guard, lowering its defense.
text.desc.ability.mend: Closes the wounds of one ally.
text.desc.ability.wide_mend: A gentle light that heals the whole party a little.
text.desc.ability.purge: Draws the poison out of one ally.
text.desc.ability.rekindle: Stands a fallen ally up with half their HP.
text.desc.ability.rally: A shout that raises the whole party's strength.
text.desc.ability.drowse: A drowsy haze that may put a group of foes to sleep.
text.desc.ability.cleave: A wide swing that cuts through a whole group.
text.desc.ability.glint: A bright flash that stings one foe with shock.
text.desc.ability.homeward: Carries the party to a town of this region it has visited. Not in dungeons.
text.desc.ability.outpath: Leads the party out of a dungeon to where it went in.
text.desc.ability.focus_shot: A careful, heavy shot at one foe. Limited uses until rest.
text.desc.ability.overclock: Pushes one's own gears faster, raising agility.
text.desc.ability.flare_burst: A burst of flame over every foe. Limited uses until rest.
text.desc.ability.hull_vent: The vehicle vents hot steam over a group of foes.
text.desc.ability.hull_patch: The crew patches the hull, restoring some of its HP.
text.desc.ability.storm_spark: Lightning and wind together strike one foe.
text.desc.ability.tempest_flare: Fire on a storm wind sweeps every foe and slows them.
text.desc.ability.mending_chorus: Voices in harmony heal the party and lift their strength.
text.desc.ability.cinder_gale: Wind carries embers through a group of foes.
text.desc.ability.brittle_frost: A hard frost on every foe that cracks their defense.
text.desc.ability.quiet_hour: A hush and a lullaby that may silence and sleep a group.
text.desc.ability.sundering_cleave: Two blades swing as one through a group of foes.
text.desc.ability.twin_arc: Two arcs of lightning meet on one foe.
text.desc.ability.pinpoint_rend: A shot opens a gap and a blade finds it.
text.desc.ability.clean_slate: Cures the party's poison and heals them a little.
text.desc.ability.surge_step: The party moves as one, raising everyone's agility.
text.desc.ability.dawn_call: A call like first light that raises the fallen and heals all.
text.desc.ability.kiln_roar: The heat of a full kiln pours over every foe.
text.desc.ability.hailstorm: Hail and lightning fall on every foe.
text.desc.ability.dream_lance: A strike that lands while the foe is lost in sleep.
text.desc.ability.venom_spit: A spat glob that hurts and may poison.
text.desc.ability.lullaby: A low hum that may put a group to sleep.
text.desc.ability.patch: A quick patch that heals a little.
text.desc.ability.numbing_sting: A sting that hurts and may paralyze.
text.desc.ability.gear_slam: A heavy swing of a gear-toothed arm.
text.desc.ability.steam_vent: A blast of steam over a group.
text.desc.ability.lock_bolt: A bolt that hurts and may jam the target's joints with Gear Lock.
text.desc.ability.muddle_spores: Spores that may jumble a group, turning them on anyone near.
text.desc.status.poison: Lingers after battle and does nothing in it. Rest or a cure removes it.
text.desc.status.sleep: Cannot act. Ends with an even chance at each round's end, or when hurt.
text.desc.status.paralysis: Cannot act; agility and dexterity drop to 1. A party member stays so until cured.
text.desc.status.silence: Techniques fail but still cost their points, until the battle ends.
text.desc.status.jumble: For two rounds, attacks someone at random instead of choosing.
text.desc.status.gear_lock: Jammed joints: cannot act. Stays after battle until oiled or cured.
text.desc.status.defeated: Out of the fight until revived.
text.desc.enemy.gel_mite: A wobbling lump of tide gel that clings to the reeds.
text.desc.enemy.rust_hound: A scrap-iron dog with a poisonous bite.
text.desc.enemy.bog_wisp: A drifting marsh light that lulls travelers to sleep.
text.desc.enemy.brass_warden: An old guardian of brass and rivets that keeps the bell cove.
text.desc.difficulty.original: The original balance: enemies, healing and rewards as first made.
text.desc.difficulty.hard: Built on smarter enemies: bosses learn new moves and resist sleep, healing techniques are weaker, and rewards rise by a fifth.
